skill.name: bamboohr-automation
skill.description: Automate BambooHR tasks through Rube MCP, including employee lookup, change tracking, time-off workflows, benefits, dependents, and employee updates.
skill.summary: Automates BambooHR HR workflows through Rube MCP with current tool schema lookup.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives caused by markdown backticks around MCP tool names, parameter names, and workflow examples. The real security considerations are the external Rube MCP trust boundary and the ability to access or change sensitive BambooHR records. No prompt injection or malware intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Document that BambooHR data passes through Rube or Composio and require approval before connecting production HR accounts.
Request only needed fields, avoid storing SSNs or dependent data, and redact PII from assistant summaries.
Add explicit confirmation before employee updates or time-off status changes, including current and proposed values.

static_findings.snippet: - Active BambooHR connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `bamboohr`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `BAMBOOHR_GET_EMPLOYEE` - Get detailed info for a specific employee [Optional]
- `fields`: Comma-separated list of fields to return (e.g., 'firstName,lastName,department,jobTitle'
- The `fields` parameter controls which fields are returned; omitting it may return minimal data
- Inactive/terminated employees may be included; check `status` field
- `since`: ISO 8601 datetime string for change detection threshold
- `since` parameter is required; use ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z')
- Field-value pairs for the fields to update (e.g., `department`, `jobTitle`, `workPhone`)
- Response data may be nested under `data` key
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Verify current values with GET_EMPLOYEE before updating to avoid overwriting
- Some operations require admin or manager-level access

content.value_statement: HR teams need accurate BambooHR actions without memorizing every tool schema. This skill guides employee lookup, time-off, benefits, dependents, and updates through Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Connects BambooHR workflows through Rube MCP and the BambooHR toolkit.
Directs the assistant to search current tool schemas before using BambooHR tools.
Lists employees and retrieves detailed employee records by numeric employee ID.
Finds recently changed employee records for incremental synchronization workflows.
Checks time-off types, balances, requests, creation, and status updates.
Guides employee field updates and dependent or benefit coverage lookups.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP connection and an authorized BambooHR account.
Available fields and actions depend on BambooHR permissions and account features.
It does not bypass BambooHR approval, audit, or role restrictions.
Sensitive HR data must be minimized, redacted, and handled under company policy.

use_cases.title: Find Employee Records
use_cases.description: Search BambooHR for employees, resolve numeric IDs, and retrieve selected fields for HR support tasks.

use_cases.title: Review Time-Off Requests
use_cases.description: Check balances, list requests, submit new requests, or prepare status changes with the required identifiers.

use_cases.title: Sync HR Changes
use_cases.description: Detect changed employees since a timestamp and gather the details needed for downstream system review.

prompt_templates.title: Find an Employee
prompt_templates.prompt: Use BambooHR to find employee records for [name]. Show matching IDs, departments, job titles, and active status. Do not change records.

prompt_templates.title: Check Time-Off Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the time-off types, then check the balance and open requests for employee [employee ID] between [start date] and [end date].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Employee Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the current BambooHR record for employee [employee ID]. Prepare an update for [field] to [new value], but wait for my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Run Incremental Sync Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Find BambooHR employee changes since [timestamp]. Retrieve selected fields for each changed employee and summarize what needs downstream review.

output_examples.input: Find Jordan Lee in BambooHR and show basic work details.
output_examples.output: Found one active employee named Jordan Lee. The summary includes employee ID, department, job title, work email, and manager field availability.

output_examples.input: Prepare a job title update for employee 284, but do not submit it yet.
output_examples.output: The current record was checked first. The proposed change lists the existing title, the new title, affected fields, and a confirmation request.

output_examples.input: Show employee changes since yesterday for a sync review.
output_examples.output: The review lists changed employee IDs, requested fields, detected change type when available, and follow-up items for downstream systems.

best_practices: Call RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS before each workflow so parameters match the current BambooHR schema.
Request only the employee fields needed for the task and redact sensitive personal data.
Require explicit approval before any employee update or time-off status change.
anti_patterns: Do not fetch all available employee fields when a limited field list is enough.
Do not approve, deny, or cancel time-off requests without a clear manager instruction.
Do not store dependent, benefit, or identity data outside approved company systems.

faq.question: Does this skill require BambooHR credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an active BambooHR connection through Rube MCP with permissions for the requested actions.

faq.question: Can it update employee records?
faq.answer: Yes, when BambooHR permissions allow it. Users should confirm every field change before submission.

faq.question: Can it approve time-off requests?
faq.answer: Yes, if the connected BambooHR account has the required manager or administrator permissions.

faq.question: Does it expose sensitive HR data?
faq.answer: It can retrieve sensitive employee, dependent, and benefit data. Use minimum necessary fields and redact outputs.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: BambooHR tool schemas can change. Searching first helps the assistant use current parameters.

faq.question: Does it work without Rube MCP?
faq.answer: No. The workflows depend on Rube MCP and its BambooHR toolkit.
